rationale: Requirements in the Agent Mode guide list Platform 10.1.x+, Cloud Connected SAIA 2.1.0+, the feature-specific AWS allowlist, Model Runtime and admin enablement. The connectivity/certificate section adds bidirectional access, region allowlisting and certificate configuration. Cloud Connected install and SAIA-9918 exclude 2.2.0–2.3.6; the 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode. Planned 2.4.0 requires fresh setup and supplies no present supported path.

exclusions: No supported Cloud Connected 2.4.0 release or tenant availability is established.
